scenarios.name: A teacher works through Teacher Training end to end — open, take a module check, pass, unlock the next
Teacher Training opens from any of its entry points
A teacher with no certificates yet is pointed back to training
A PDF module arrives as a document
Finishing every module unlocks the level exam, and passing it certifies the level
Asking for a certificate by its code sends the PDF
For a Beacon House programme the level exam is written answers, not multiple choice
For an Oxbridge programme a level is certified from module scores, with no exam
A locked level is selectable but the server refuses to open it
A module further down the list can't be opened before the earlier ones
Tapping the locked exam link explains what to finish first
Getting one question wrong fails the module check (NIETE needs 100%) and offers a retry
Asking for a certificate that isn't mine says it can't be found
A /certificate with a junk code just shows my certificates list
"/teacher training" (two words) is not a training command
Failing the level exam starts a wait before I can retry
An Urdu teacher gets the Urdu question text and Urdu options
/training works even in the middle of something else
Pausing a module check saves my place
A module retake serves a fresh set of questions
A half-finished module quiz picks up where I left off
A module's button is named after what tapping it does
A very long answer option is shown in full, not cut off
Completing the Pick Class Flow delivers the lesson-plan PDF
A recognised keyword opens the Lesson Plans Flow
A secondary grade delivers a Pakistan lesson plan, not an Oxbridge one
Rating a 6-12 lesson plan useful asks whether I taught it
The use question is asked in my language, not the document's
A natural-language request returns the curriculum fallback, not a generated plan
A voice lesson-plan request is transcribed and answered like the text path
A thumbs-down asks why, and never asks whether I taught it
A grade with no lesson plans shows a friendly message
A subject with no chapters for that grade is refused politely
"/lesson plan" is not a recognised keyword and falls through to natural language
A photo gets no reply when pic-to-LP is disabled
The Pick Class Flow renders in English for an Urdu-preference teacher
/language opens a bilingual picker offering EXACTLY Urdu and English (no Auto-detect)
Selecting English confirms in English and persists the choice, locked
Selecting Urdu confirms IN Urdu and persists the choice, locked
/language is case-insensitive
A stale client replaying an off-offer row is rejected by the writer, not stored
The coaching transcription path cannot re-language a locked account
No dead language-lock reader export exists (removed 2026-08-11, bd-2485)
The registration launch bubble is English regardless of any prior language
Ask Anything answers an Urdu account in Urdu, and drift is logged
/observe — the whole visit flow renders bot CONTENT in Urdu, but the Flow chrome stays English
Lesson Plans via the natural-language path answers in the chosen language
Teacher Training ENTRY launcher is localized (entry only)
/menu renders English on an Urdu account
/status answers in Urdu on an Urdu account
Lesson Plans via the Pick-Class Flow renders English on an Urdu account
A Grade 1-5 Pick-Class lesson plan is served in Urdu only if an Urdu PDF exists (else English)
Coaching progress steps render English on an Urdu account, but the interstitials render Urdu
A coach reads the observation flow in the COACH's language, not the observed teacher's
A refusal for a cancelled session is worded in my language
A new teacher is offered Urdu first; English is only the emergency floor (D4)
A lesson plan keeps the language it was enqueued with, even if I switch mid-generation (D3)
An off-market language arriving from outside the offer is narrowed AND logged (D5)
A bare "language" (no slash) does not open the picker
